record.title: Agent-run GitHub CLI installer may run a project-planted winget.exe on Windows
record.description: The installer invokes `winget.exe` by bare name with `shell:false`, inherits its caller's environment, and does not set a working directory. If the agent runs the suggested setup script from an untrusted project and its Node process lacks `NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1`, Windows may resolve a project-local `winget.exe` before the system executable. The parent platform probe observed cwd-first resolution for `gh.exe` and `winget.exe` when that variable was unset, and PATH resolution when it was set. The probe did not run repository code. Whether the agent's actual script process has that environment variable and project working directory remains unverified.
record.claimed_root_cause: The installer passes bare executable names to `spawn` and inherits the caller's working directory and environment. The hook's setup note suggests running the installer when `gh` is absent. The parent probe confirms cwd-first resolution when `NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath` is unset, but this run does not establish the environment or working directory used when an agent executes the installer.

trace.description: When the probe is absent, the generated setup note gives the agent the command to run the installer script.
On Windows the package manager is the bare name `winget.exe`.
The installer probes the selected manager by bare name before invoking it with install arguments.
`spawn` receives the bare filename with `shell:false`, inherited environment, and no explicit cwd.

evidence.description: The spawn options inherit the caller's environment and omit cwd.
The Windows package-manager executable is selected as bare `winget.exe`.
The setup note is generated only for the absent probe state.
The note directs the agent to invoke the installer script.

blockers: The parent platform probe confirmed cwd-first resolution with `NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath` unset, but whether Claude Code or Codex passes that variable to the agent shell and then to the installer process is unknown. The probe artifact states that the variable was present only in the current session's tool process environment, not in the User or Machine environment.

The working directory used when the agent follows the setup note is not established for either supported host. The possible project-local executable therefore has not been shown to run through the actual installer flow.

validation_plan.local: In an approved Windows VM with a disposable user profile and no network, inspect the environment and cwd inherited by a harmless child process launched in the same way the agent runs the installer. Use a benign test executable named `winget.exe` that only prints a fixed marker; do not invoke the installer or a package manager. Repeat with `NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath` unset and set to `1`, and record whether the current-directory executable or PATH executable is selected. Keep the target repository read-only and use no real credentials or project data.
validation_plan.deployment: In disposable Claude Code and Codex profiles, use a throwaway project containing a harmless marker executable named `winget.exe`. Without running the installer, determine the cwd and whether `NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath` is present in the process environment that would launch the suggested command. If testing the complete flow is later approved, use a benign substitute executable that only records a fixed marker and never installs software.
